faq.question: What is a quick-change utility knife?
faq.answer: A quick-change structure is intended to make blade replacement more efficient; confirm the selected mechanism and blade format with the supplier.

faq.question: Can the industrial box cutter use an OEM logo?
faq.answer: Logo marking, body color, blade-pack, packaging artwork and barcode requirements can be reviewed.

faq.question: Which blade options can be discussed?
faq.answer: The page lists a trapezoid blade with SK5 or selected blade option; confirm the required blade specification in the RFQ.

faq.question: What quality checks matter?
faq.answer: Inspection can cover quick-change function, blade fit and sharpness, lock behavior, zinc alloy body finish, packing and replacement blade quantity.
